raw_segments.text: there is a very great difference between the mortality of the Blacks and of the
whites in the states in which slavery is abolished. From 1820 to 1830, one only one
out of 42 individuals of the white population died in Philadelphia, but one
Negro out of 21 individuals of the black population died in the same space of
time. The mortality is by no means so great amongst the Negroes who are still
slaves. See Emerson's medical statistics p28.
